title: Division as grouping: how many 4s in 12?
examples: What is the difference between sharing and grouping?

explain.say: You have 12 eggs, and each egg box holds 4. How many boxes do you need? That is division too, called grouping. Look at the number line: we hop back from 12 in jumps of 4, all the way to 0.

draw.text: Division as grouping: how many 4s in 12?

explain.say: Fill the first box: take 4 eggs away. That is one hop back, from 12 to 8. One box full! See the first jump of 4? How many eggs are left?
Fill a second box: hop back another 4, from 8 to 4. So far we have taken 8 eggs from 12, and 4 are left. Can you guess how many more hops we need?
One more hop of 4 lands on 0. Count the hops: 1, 2, 3. So there are 3 fours in 12, and 12 divided by 4 equals 3. You need 3 boxes. Landing on 0 means no eggs are left over!
Great job! Look: 3 boxes of 4 eggs make 12 again. Sharing asks how many in each group; grouping asks how many groups. Challenge: how many 5s are in 20?

faq.a: Grouping means making groups of a set size and counting how many groups you get. 12 eggs in boxes of 4 make 3 boxes, so 12 divided by 4 is 3.
asks: What does grouping mean in division?

faq.a: There are 3 fours in 12. Hop back from 12 in jumps of 4: 8, 4, 0. That is 3 hops.

faq.q: What is the difference between sharing and grouping?
faq.a: In sharing, you know how many groups and find how many go in each. In grouping, you know the size of each group and find how many groups. Both are division.
asks: Is sharing the same as grouping?

faq.a: It means taking away the same number again and again. Taking 4 from 12 three times reaches 0, so 12 divided by 4 is 3.
asks: Why do we take away to divide?

faq.a: There are 4 fives in 20. Hop back 5 at a time: 15, 10, 5, 0. That is 4 hops.

facts: Division can mean sharing into a number of groups or grouping into sets of a given size; both give the same answer.

quiz.say: 18 children make teams of 6. How many teams?
quiz.show: 18 children make teams of 6. How many teams?

wrong.1: 12 is 18 take away 6, which is just one team made.

quiz.say: You hop back from 15 to 0 in jumps of 5. How many hops?
quiz.show: You hop back from 15 to 0 in jumps of 5. How many hops?

wrong.0: 5 is the size of each hop.
